errors.evidence: The figure shows 8 investment opportunities listed in the table, but the pie chart itself has 6 visible sectors plus an exploded 'Other' grouping in the main pie and a secondary inset pie; the description frames the chart as having eight sectors, which is misleading for the pie visualization.
In the inset pie, 4EH is light blue and 5PET is light green, not both blue.

ETH_USD is shown in pale yellow, which is acceptable, but the description later assigns the same yellow category to the main pie's ETH_USD in a way that conflates the inset with the main pie; more importantly, the main pie does not have an ETH_USD slice.

The label 'Other 6%' appears as a grouping connected to the main pie, but it is not one of the eight listed investment opportunities and is not a separate sector in the table; describing it as part of the set of sectors is misleading.

errors.evidence: The chart does not visually present all sectors in a simple descending order around a single pie. It is a main pie with an exploded 'Other' branch leading to a second inset pie, so this structural description is inaccurate.

The 'Other' slice in the main pie is dark gray, but the description treats it as part of the same sector-color inventory as the eight portfolio items; this is misleading because 'Other' is not a listed portfolio component.
The description does not mention the exploded/offset slice styling of the main pie and the connecting lines to the inset pie, both of which are prominent visual features.

The description mentions 'Портфейл 5' and shares, but does not clearly state that the pie chart compares the composition/allocation of the portfolio visually from the labels alone in a concise opening statement as requested.
